My dear [Miss Sewell](/person/1301)[^2]
I think you will like to see what the [Literary Churchman](/periodical/76) says of our [performance](/book/71) but please return it

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Do you know anyone who would like one of these photos I am selling them towards the school at Eastleigh[^2]


[^2]: The name has been erased in ink.
